verdict.rationale: Featurebase's feedback portal and public roadmap (docs-15, docs-19) let PMs link feedback to roadmap status, and shipped requests trigger automatic notifications tied to releases (docs-12), showing feedback-to-roadmap-to-release linkage. However, there's no explicit evidence of linking feedback to distinct 'initiatives' or of a dedicated release-note linking workflow beyond notifications. Missing for 10: explicit initiative-linking feature, structured release/roadmap item association beyond notifications, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
